output.title: How DNS Works
output.summary: How a human-friendly domain name becomes a numeric address through resolvers, root, top level domain and authoritative servers.

scenes.narration: Every website you visit starts with a name that computers cannot read. Machines talk to each other using numeric addresses, never words.
scenes.visualBrief: A browser address bar typing a domain name that morphs into a row of digits.

scenes.narration: At last, the authoritative server for the domain gives the real address. This server is run by whoever owns the domain, or their hosting company.
